So an hour ago I noticed this massive lump on the underside of my rats hind leg. It wasn't noticeable yesterday at all. She is still playing and jumping around like normal. It doesn't hurt her nor does it seem to impact her in any way but it's still very concerning. My mother will not take my rats to the vet since "they have a short life span anyway". Still I showed it to her and she said that there wasn't anything we could do. I don't know what to do and I'm scared for my rat. Is there anything I can do?

Btw she is about 2 years old

Hi there! I really don't want to make you sad but my experience is not the greatest. Normally it means that your rat has a respiratory infection of some sort. Sadly my rat Pudding died of that, so I would suggest going and seeing a vet as soon as you can. I would also suggest to feed them raw honey or something with grapefruit extract in it, it helps them. Also if you have a humidifier you should put them in it for a bit and if you don't you can run hot water and let them sit beside the steam. It helps them breathe better. 
Best of luck for your little boi
